summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of Vendor Onboarding & MDM Portal. Backend: 29 pytest cases covering health, JWT auth flows, vendor CRUD, full workflow (submit → reviewer → approver → SAP mapping), reject/revision branches, document attach + verify, Cloudinary signature, admin user mgmt, stats, and role-based authorization — all 29 PASSED. Frontend: smoke-tested admin, vendor (register → onboarding multi-step), and reviewer flows on the deployed preview — all role-appropriate sidebars, data-testids, workflow actions, and toast notifications behave correctly.

issues: React Router v6 future-flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) appear in console — non-blocking, but cleanup would silence noise

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~750 lines — single-file backend is acceptable for current scope but consider splitting routers (auth/vendors/admin) as the surface grows.
POST /api/vendors/{id}/sap-mapping does not validate company_code is one of ('1000','3000','5000') — spec mentions these explicitly; currently any string is accepted.
POST /api/vendors/{id}/submit allows submission when compliance/bank exist as empty dicts (model defaults make all fields Optional) — consider requiring at least pan + account_number + ifsc_code.
Cloudinary api_secret is read directly from os.environ at request time inside signature endpoint — safe, but better to capture at startup and KeyError early if missing.
Vendor PATCH does not validate GSTIN/PAN/IFSC format — Indian regulatory format checks (regex) would catch garbage data before workflow.
/api/auth/refresh issues a new access_token but never rotates the refresh token; consider rotation for defence in depth.
Reviewer/Approver/SAP team currently see ALL vendors at their stage globally — for a multi-tenant deployment add entity/region scoping.
test_credentials: Used seeded creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin@keva.com/Admin@123, reviewer@keva.com/Review@123, approver@keva.com/Approve@123, sap@keva.com/Sap@123, vendor@test.com/Vendor@123. Backend startup correctly upserts password_hash and role when seed users already exist with different password (verified via test_login_and_me for all 5 roles).
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_-prefixed throwaway vendor records were created during pytest runs (e.g. ven_bff795e3ae5a, ven_7da76fb99cfe). These are intentionally orphaned for reviewer-queue visibility and can be cleaned by dropping db.vendors where legal_name starts with 'TEST '.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is rock-solid. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py is idempotent (uses uuid-suffixed emails) and safe to re-run. Frontend testids match the implementation (login-*, register-*, vtype-*, step-*, create-vendor-btn, vendor-row-*, vendor-list-row-*, action-approve/action-reject/action-revise/action-review-approve, role-select-*, toggle-active-*, cta-onboarding). Note: vendor register redirects directly to /onboarding if owner has no vendor yet, and /dashboard does show the 'No vendor record yet' card with the cta-onboarding button. The Google sign-in button is present on /login but its handler just redirects externally — do not follow that flow.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found. One self-induced test assertion (email case) was corrected: backend lowercases emails on register/login (intentional and correct), so the test now compares against email.lower().
